## Findings
- [ ] **[BLOCK][Docs] Homebrew distribution information is inconsistent and the local formula is not installable**
  - **Status quo:** `README.md` tells users to run `brew install symaira/tap/symvibe` and references `homebrew/symvibe.rb`. The release config `.goreleaser.yml` publishes the formula to `danieljustus/homebrew-tap` (which Homebrew resolves as `danieljustus/tap/symvibe`). The local `homebrew/symvibe.rb` still contains `sha256 "PLACEHOLDER_UPDATE_ON_RELEASE"`, so even after its URL was updated to v0.4.1 it cannot be used by `brew install`.
  - **Likely cause:** The local formula was kept as a manual source-of-truth copy, but GoReleaser now owns the tap release; the README and `.goreleaser.yml` have drifted apart.
  - **Proposed solution:** Pick one canonical tap and align all three places: either move/keep `homebrew-tap` under `symaira` (update `.goreleaser.yml` and README) or keep `danieljustus/homebrew-tap` (update README to `danieljustus/tap/symvibe`). Replace the placeholder `sha256` with the real archive hash for the target release, or remove the local formula if it is no longer used.
  - **Handoff:** `/02-gh-plan --from-review` or `/03-gh-go`
